svg.aria-label: Two water tanks in cascade. The pump flow 1 + u fills the upper tank, whose level deviation is x1; it drains through an outlet into the lower tank, level deviation x2, which drains to the sump. Right: with exact linearization and v chosen for a double pole at −1, the lower level y = x2 follows a step to 0.5 with no overshoot, and the input settles at about 0.22
